collection.description: A child asks why an artist spends hours on a picture nobody needs for survival.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (child) asks why (artist), an artist, spends hours on a picture nobody needs for survival.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (artist) says pictures can communicate feelings and ideas.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (child) draws a playful scene from village life.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (child) dislikes the first drawing and tries another.

text_only.reason: a feeling in the moment, not a lasting dislike -- the volume's outcomes are story text unless an effect is marked

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (elder) explains patterns used in ceremonies without insisting they are universal.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (child) creates a new pattern inspired by an old one.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (child) learns that joy and beauty can matter even without practical use.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (child) asks whether songs count as art too.
